issue.title: Backend unit test sometimes locks up
issue.body:

issue.title: Enable backend to accept connection URL

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This allows the backend_bin to be started with any connection URL.

Resolves #587.

issue.title: backend: remove sometimes failing unit tests

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
Sometimes TryCancel's best effort is not good enough and it does not seem to be able to cancel it. This means that the promise is blocked in the ServiceImpls and destruction hangs.

Fixes #731.
